units.source_text: 此后源氏内大臣继续准备夕雾入学之事。

en.t: After this, Genji, the Minister of the Interior, continued making preparations for Yugiri's entrance into studies.

units.source_text: 他在东院内为夕雾辟一房室，请一位学识渊博的师傅来，在这里教他研习学问。

en.t: In the eastern residence, he set aside a room for Yugiri and invited a deeply learned tutor to teach him there.

units.source_text: 夕雾自从行过冠礼之后，外祖母处也难得去。

en.t: Since undergoing his coming-of-age ceremony, Yugiri had hardly been able to visit his grandmother.

units.source_text: 因为外祖母溺爱外孙，朝夕护持，当他婴儿一般，他住在那边不能用功。

en.t: Because his grandmother doted on her grandson, watched over him morning and evening, and treated him like an infant, he could not study diligently while staying there.

units.source_text: 所以要他在东院笼闭一室，只允许他每月拜访外祖母三次。

en.t: Therefore, he was made to stay secluded in a room at the eastern residence and was allowed to visit his grandmother only three times a month.

units.source_text: 夕雾笼闭在东院内，颇感沉闷之苦。

en.t: Confined within the eastern residence, Yugiri felt the misery of great tedium.

units.source_text: 他想：“父亲管得我太严厉了。

en.t: He thought, "Father is far too strict with me.

units.source_text: 我不须如此苦学，亦可晋升高位，重用于世呢。”

en.t: Even without studying so painfully, I could still rise to high rank and be put to important use in the world."
In his heart, he could not help feeling resentful.

units.source_text: 然而这个人毕竟生性严谨，并无浮薄之气，因此颇能忍苦。

en.t: Yet he was, after all, naturally serious and disciplined, with nothing frivolous about him, and so he was quite able to endure hardship.

units.source_text: 他打算将应读之书尽行读完，早日加入群臣之列，立身用世。

en.t: He intended to finish reading all the books required of him, join the ranks of the courtiers as soon as possible, establish himself, and serve the world.

units.source_text: 果然只消四五个月，已经读完《史记》等书。

en.t: Sure enough, in only four or five months, he had already finished reading the Records of the Grand Historian and other books.
